request_text: We are in the oh-my-openagent monorepo (packages/senpi-task, packages/omo-senpi, packages/omo-opencode). Three independent research tracks, then a combined report: (1) find every test file under packages/senpi-task that uses fixed sleeps or timers to wait for async behavior and list them with line numbers; (2) explain how packages/omo-opencode delivers background task completions to the parent session, citing files; (3) list every changes.md and CHANGELOG.md tracker in the repo with the path each one covers. Hand each track to a subagent, then write the combined report. Also: I want the ultrabrain category to review the combined report before you finish.
